enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Sheltering +5: +5 Insight bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings
Rough Hide +3: This item fuses with your body and toughens your skin, providing a +3 Primal bonus to your natural armor.
Natural Armor +4: Passive: +4 Natural Armor Bonus to Armor Class.
